purpose: Owner-approved shared faction backdrops behind unit portraits and UI icons. Foreground cutouts remain separate.

items.prompt: Create a single SQUARE, completely opaque background-only raster asset for a fantasy strategy game's unit portrait and army icon. This is a reusable empty background, NOT a card mockup. Original painterly 2D fantasy illustration matching finely painted miniature creatures, rich natural materials, restrained brushwork, atmospheric depth. It must remain readable reduced to 160x160 or 64x64. Keep the central 65 percent very quiet, softly shaded, low contrast, empty, free of detailed objects; a creature will be drawn over this background later. Faction identity should come from broad environmental shapes at the far left and right edges, a restrained palette, and light, rather than emblems. Perspective: eye-level distant backdrop, no strong vanishing-point lines, horizon around lower middle, unobtrusive dark ground near bottom. Soft edge vignette; no rendered border. Fill the entire square edge to edge. No text, no letters, no numbers, no dots, no stars, no heraldic logos, no frame, no card edges, no people, no creatures, no weapons, no foreground props, no spotlight circle. This must be an attractive but subordinate background behind existing character art. Embercourt League: a river-law civilization of lock cities, civic stone quays, mill islands and beacon towers. Background: a distant warm limestone river lock and small beacon arch only at the outer edges, broad slate-blue river haze through the center, muted copper dusk and warm amber rim light, low charcoal-brown stone at the foot. NOT a generic medieval castle and not a fiery lava scene. Keep the center cool and muted to contrast with red and brass soldiers.
